meaning.en: Putting things off again and again hurts you in the end.

proverbs.literal: after hardship, relief

meaning.en: Hard times don't last; relief comes after them.

proverbs.literal: there is nothing so long that it has no end

meaning.en: Everything, however long, has an end.

proverbs.literal: there is no bad patience

meaning.en: Patience is never the wrong choice.

proverbs.literal: one who won't listen to an elder breaks a leg

meaning.en: Ignore wise advice and you will get hurt.

proverbs.literal: to ask is not stupidity

meaning.en: Asking questions is not foolish; it is how you learn.

proverbs.literal: the one who asks has knowledge

meaning.en: The person who asks ends up being the one who knows.

proverbs.literal: sweet words draw a snake out of its hole

meaning.en: Kind, gentle words can win over even a hard person.

proverbs.literal: one who does not ask has nothing he learns

meaning.en: No questions, no learning.

proverbs.literal: to lose the road is to learn the road

meaning.en: Getting it wrong is how you learn to get it right.

proverbs.literal: bend the fish while it is still fresh

meaning.en: Teach and shape a child while they are young.

proverbs.literal: sense is wealth

meaning.en: Your mind is your riches; what you know can feed you.

proverbs.literal: every door with its own key

meaning.en: Every problem has its own answer. Find the right one.

proverbs.text: Asiyefunzwa na mamaye hufunzwa na ulimwengu.
proverbs.literal: one not taught by his mother is taught by the world

meaning.en: If you won't be taught gently, life will teach you hard.

proverbs.literal: to live much is to see much

meaning.en: The longer you live, the more you have seen.

proverbs.text: Akili ni nywele, kila mtu ana zake.
proverbs.literal: sense is like hair, everyone has their own

meaning.en: Everyone thinks their own way. Respect that.

proverbs.literal: a promise is a debt

meaning.en: What you promised, you owe. Keep your word.

proverbs.literal: the liar's road is short

meaning.en: Lies do not go far. Honesty lasts.

proverbs.literal: a person is people

meaning.en: You are nothing on your own; people make you.

proverbs.literal: unity is strength

meaning.en: Together you are strong.

proverbs.literal: one finger does not crush a louse

meaning.en: One person alone cannot do it; you need another hand.

proverbs.literal: one hearthstone does not hold the pot

meaning.en: One support is not enough; it takes three to hold the pot.

proverbs.literal: where there are many, there is much

meaning.en: Many people means many opinions — and much gets done.

proverbs.literal: let the guest come so the host may be relieved

meaning.en: A guest coming is a blessing on the house.

proverbs.literal: blood is heavier than water

meaning.en: Family ties hold when nothing else does.

proverbs.literal: don't drop your old mat for a passing prayer mat

meaning.en: Don't drop an old friend for a shiny new one.

proverbs.literal: if you don't seal the crack you will build a wall

meaning.en: Fix the small problem now or rebuild the whole thing later.

proverbs.literal: don't wake the sleeper, if you wake him you will sleep

meaning.en: Leave a resting thing alone, or the trouble becomes yours.

proverbs.literal: a sick person is not asked about porridge

meaning.en: When someone is ill, just care for them. Don't ask, do.

proverbs.literal: if you fall ill, have patience

meaning.en: When you're sick, be patient — healing takes its time.

proverbs.literal: one who sleeps early wakes early

meaning.en: Sleep early and the morning is yours.

proverbs.literal: a loudly sounding drum does not last

meaning.en: What roars loudest burns out fastest.
